company_name: 广东顺威精密塑料股份有限公司
decision_frame: Pre-outcome underwriting at 2018-12-31 using only FY2015-FY2017 disclosed evidence; no price, valuation result, return or action is formed.
underwriting_route: Separate mature blade economics from unsegmented and growth projects, then test survival financing and owner-cash conversion with explicit unknowns.

situation_model.summary: The company is a direct-to-end-customer manufacturer of plastic air-conditioner blades with an integrated modification, tooling and blade-design chain. Revenue rose through FY2017 but adjusted profit and operating cash were volatile while working capital, debt and new-project commitments expanded.

industry_future_thesis.horizon: 2018-12-31 forward, early signal and normalization horizons
industry_future_thesis.most_likely_regime: Category and channel demand can grow in aggregate while product mix, inventory absorption and supplier economics diverge across companies.
industry_future_thesis.profit_pool_transmission: Aggregate appliance growth reaches this company through OEM specifications, order volumes, resin and labor costs, inventory absorption, customer concentration and working-capital funding; aggregate data alone cannot establish realized price, margin or cash conversion.
industry_future_thesis.company_exposure: Exposure is central to room-air-conditioner channel component manufacturing, with direct sales to major domestic and international OEMs and a production-to-order model; segment economics outside blades are not separately disclosed.
industry_future_thesis.adaptation: The integrated modification-tooling-blade chain and overseas Thailand capacity may support customer retention and localization, but Thailand, smart-bathroom and other expansion projects require separate evidence of utilization and returns.
industry_future_thesis.normal_economics: A normalized case should anchor on recurring blade operations, remove identified non-recurring charges and avoid treating unsegmented businesses or project spending as proven earnings.
industry_future_thesis.permanent_loss: Permanent loss can arise from sustained cost pressure, inventory impairment, customer concentration, refinancing stress or unsuccessful expansion; evidence is presently insufficient to rank these paths quantitatively.
industry_future_thesis.valuation_treatment: Use mature blade earnings as the primary route, a conditional route for unsegmented modification/plastics and explicit corroborative or scenario routes for cash pressure and growth projects; leave unresolved items out of base ranges.
industry_future_thesis.strongest_rival: The strongest competitive explanation is that apparent industry growth reflects aggregate mix, exports or channel migration rather than company-level realized price, inventory quality, capital efficiency or owner-cash improvement.
reversal_observations: Company same-scope disclosure shows category or channel exposure inconsistent with the official common environment, or national aggregates cannot enter its target product market.
Changes in sell-through are explained by exports, seasonality, accounting scope or inventory relocation and do not transmit to company demand or cash.
Acquisitions, consolidation changes, financing or product-boundary changes make cross-period earnings, working capital or capital spending incomparable.
Company evidence shows realized price, unit cost, customer absorption or cash collection moving opposite to the candidate main path.

business_position: Core position is an integrated plastic air-conditioner blade supplier serving Gree, Midea, Chigo, TCL and international OEMs; top-five customers represented 49.48%-53.09% of sales in FY2015-FY2017, so concentration and bargaining power remain material unknowns.
survival_case: FY2017 short-term borrowings rose to 350,518,642.19 and a 50,000,000 loan became current, while cash was 230,633,952.25 and operating cash flow was only 7,192,529.44. Survival therefore depends on renewed customer collections, inventory discipline and refinancing capacity; no covenant breach or restricted-asset issue is disclosed for FY2016-FY2017.
adaptation_case: The integrated modification-tooling-blade process and Thailand plant completed for planned 2018 production provide adaptation options, but smart-bathroom, automation, electronics and other projects lack standalone revenue, margin or cash evidence and remain conditional or scenario items.
normalization_case: FY2016 reported 30,796,656.99 net income and 81,029,398.97 operating cash, while FY2017 reported a 48,039,752.06 net loss and 7,192,529.44 operating cash. Raw-material and labor inflation, 23,005,500 inventory impairment, project setup, restructuring fees, financing and FX costs and a 7,200,000 dispute payment are identified; recurring blade earnings can only be bounded conditionally around the disclosed FY2016 reference because segment margins and FY2018 results are absent.
permanent_loss_map: Primary loss paths are persistent cost inflation with OEM price pressure, inventory obsolescence, concentrated-customer disruption, and debt-funded expansion that cannot earn its cost. Current evidence supports monitoring and conditional paths, not a quantified probability or terminal loss estimate.

value_route.route_reasoning: Primary routes are limited to recurring blade earnings and a conditional route for modification/plastics because the source package lacks segment profitability. Owner cash is corroborative through operating cash less long-lived-asset spending, while Thailand and smart-bathroom projects are scenario or stress routes only.

strongest_rival: The strongest competitive explanation is that apparent industry growth reflects aggregate mix, exports or channel migration rather than company-level realized price, inventory quality, capital efficiency or owner-cash improvement.
reversal_observations: Company same-scope disclosure shows category or channel exposure inconsistent with the official common environment, or national aggregates cannot enter its target product market.

component_treatments.reason: Air-conditioner blades are the documented core product with direct OEM sales and a production-to-order model, but product-level margin is not disclosed.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Use as the only base operating anchor; keep customer concentration and cost pass-through as monitoring risks.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote confidence when same-scope blade volume, realized price, unit cost and cash collection are disclosed for at least one subsequent annual cycle.

component_treatments.reason: Modification is part of the stated chain, but separate income, margin and cash are not disclosed.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Allow a conditional earnings route only; do not add an independent base contribution.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote after segment revenue, margin, working capital and capital spending are separately reported and reconciled.

component_treatments.reason: Tooling and other precision components are described but lack comparable standalone financial data.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Exclude from base and leave its value contribution unresolved.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Resolve with standalone orders, gross margin, asset intensity and cash conversion evidence.

component_treatments.reason: Thailand plant construction was completed with planned 2018 production, while setup costs and utilization returns are not yet evidenced.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Treat as growth scenario and financing stress exposure, never as current earnings.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote only after audited utilization, local margins, remittances and incremental capital returns are disclosed.

component_treatments.reason: Smart-bathroom and related new directions are in preparation without separate revenue, profit or cash flow disclosure.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Keep outside base earnings and owner cash; include only in an explicit expansion scenario.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote after a separately identified operating perimeter has recurring sales and cash evidence.

component_treatments.reason: Receivables, inventory and debt balances materially changed across FY2015-FY2017 and directly determine funding pressure, although customer-level terms are unknown.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Use as corroborative owner-cash and stress-financing component; do not convert financing pressure into an earnings point estimate.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Resolve with customer aging, collection history, inventory turns, debt maturities and cash interest disclosures.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Disclose same-scope blade volume, price, cost and cash conversion.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Sustained OEM volume or price decline with rising unit cost and inventory impairment invalidates the base path.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Segment reporting demonstrates recurring margin and cash.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Evidence of structurally subscale or loss-making modification operations removes the conditional route.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Standalone economics and asset intensity are disclosed.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Continued absence of separable evidence keeps this component unbound.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Audited post-launch utilization and incremental returns exceed funding cost.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Idle capacity, losses or unrecovered capital keep Thailand outside base value.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Separate recurring sales, margins and cash returns are evidenced.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Persistent pre-revenue spending or write-offs exclude the project from value.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Stable collections and debt rollover reduce the funding drag.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Accelerating receivables or inventory with refinancing failure creates a permanent-loss path.

underwriting_thesis.central_path: Underwrite the recurring blade platform conditionally around disclosed historical earnings, while financing and project execution determine whether growth spending creates value or permanent loss.
underwriting_thesis.normal_earnings_treatment: Base-range authority is limited to the mature blade component; modification/plastics is conditional and tooling is unresolved because segment economics are absent.
underwriting_thesis.owner_cash_treatment: Use operating cash less long-lived-asset spending as a corroborative range only; maintenance versus growth spending and customer cash conversion are not fully separable.
underwriting_thesis.permanent_loss_treatment: Monitor cost inflation, inventory impairment, customer concentration and refinancing; Thailand and smart-bathroom commitments are stress/scenario paths rather than base claims.
underwriting_thesis.value_route_treatment: Primary earnings routes are blade and conditional modification/plastics; owner cash corroborates, while noncore tooling is excluded and growth projects remain scenario-only.
underwriting_thesis.strongest_rival: The strongest competitive explanation is that apparent industry growth reflects aggregate mix, exports or channel migration rather than company-level realized price, inventory quality, capital efficiency or owner-cash improvement.
underwriting_thesis.monitoring: At the early-signal clock, check same-scope blade orders, pricing, costs and inventory; at normalization-and-cash, check audited segment margins, collections, capex split, debt maturities and project returns.

investment_treatment: Pre-outcome research treatment only: maintain a conditional underwriting stance with explicit unresolved and scenario components; no price, valuation result, expected return, BuyBand or investment action.

basis.operating_perimeter: Consolidated FY2015-FY2017 perimeter with mature blade operations as base
